title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Demetris Azoides and Dimitar Kuzmanov in the Hersonissos 4, originally scheduled for November 23, 2026 at 3:00AM ET.
This market will resolve to "Demetris Azoides" if Demetris Azoides wins by 2 or more sets than Dimitar Kuzmanov, based on the final completed score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Dimitar Kuzmanov."
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the deciding set has begun when the match ends, Demetris Azoides can no longer win by 2 or more sets, and this market will resolve to "Dimitar Kuzmanov."
If the match is canceled before play begins, or a result has not been determined by December 7, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger results.
